description: This file is a C++ header defining interfaces, component definitions using the Fruit dependency injection framework, and function declarations for the 'launch' commands related to the 'run_cvd' component in the Android Cuttlefish project. It includes function prototypes for connecting to various hardware simulators and services, and component assembly functions for dependency injection.
